# Quantum Imaginary Time Propagation Engine (QITE)

Qiskit-based simulation framework implementing Quantum Imaginary Time Propagation
using a unitary approximation of imaginary time evolution.

Features
- Modular architecture
- Pauli Hamiltonians
- QITE propagation engine
- Qiskit Aer simulation backend

Use cases
- Ground state preparation
- Spin systems
- Quantum algorithm research
